text:
MR::stream
Description
This iRule command start egressing bytes previously collected and
stored. Use end to indicate final payload segment.
Syntax
MR
::
stream
<
payload
>
MR
::
stream
end
<
payload
>
Examples
when
MR_EGRESS
{
MR
::
stream
end
"abcd"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
MR_EGRESS
